tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground behind panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels: pipeline canvas frame, inspector, tables.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: the graph canvas, table headers, code and config values.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, panel borders, matrix grid. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and graph edges; at least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, units, timestamps on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interactive only: links, selected tab, primary button fill, focus ring. Never a task or group state.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (primary button).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px offset; 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: state-active
tokens.usage: Active task owned by a member; STABLE group state. Text and chip border on state-active-bg, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: state-active-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of an owned active task chip and of STABLE badges.

tokens.name: state-standby
tokens.usage: Standby task (state replica on another process). Text and chip border on state-standby-bg, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: state-standby-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of an owned standby chip.

tokens.name: state-warmup
tokens.usage: Warm-up task restoring state before it becomes active. Text and border on state-warmup-bg and surfaces.

tokens.name: state-warmup-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a warm-up chip.

tokens.name: state-revoking
tokens.usage: Task the member must give up (UNREVOKED_TASKS), RECONCILING and ASSIGNING groups. Text on state-revoking-bg and surfaces.

tokens.name: state-revoking-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of revoking chips and RECONCILING badges.

tokens.name: state-fenced
tokens.usage: Crashed or fenced member, task with no owner, errors. Always with a word or the × glyph. Text on state-fenced-bg and surfaces.

tokens.name: state-fenced-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of crashed badges and the error banner.

tokens.name: state-idle
tokens.usage: EMPTY, NOT_READY, joining: nothing assigned yet. Text on surface and surface-raised.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Group name in the page header. Once per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tasks move to the survivor after the session timeout.
styles.usage: Running text, descriptions, table cells with words.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body: process labels, column heads.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels and section eyebrows; ink-muted.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Topic names, task ids, member ids, config keys and values.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Task chips, epochs inside dense cells, log timestamps.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Headline numbers: group epoch, task count, lag. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a chip's glyph and text; inside dense cells.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, badge padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding in dense views; gap between graph nodes and edges' labels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the summary row and the pipeline graph.

tokens.name: radius-cell
tokens.usage: Task chips, topic pills, inputs inside tables.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, graph nodes, buttons, menus.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: State badges only.

shadow.note: Hairlines separate; shadows only lift what floats above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips and the task detail popover.

meta.note: Direction set by the user (Flink-style pipeline console); state vocabulary from the dashboard's matrix and Spec 001.
